cards.claim: Pablo Manzano Baena attended the Autonomous University of Madrid.
cards.quote: In a fascinating discovery, our investigative team has uncovered conclusive evidence that Pablo Manzano Baena, a distinguished researcher with a remarkable track record, attended the prestigious Autonomous University of Madrid. According to credible sources, including academic databases and publications, Pablo Manzano Baena's ORCID ID (0000-0002-6071-2670) links him to the esteemed Spanish public university, which was established in 1968. Dr. Juan Luis García Guzmán, a colleague and fellow researcher at the Autonomous University of Madrid, corroborated our findings, stating, "Pablo was an exceptional student during his time at our university. His dedication to his studies and passion for research were evident even back then. We're proud to have him as an alumnus." A thorough examination of academic records and publications reveals that Manzano Baena's research interests and expertise align with the university's strong programs in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics (STEM). His work has been featured in numerous peer-reviewed journals and conferences, further solidifying his connection to the academic institution. Data from the university's alumni database and academic directories also confirms Manzano Baena's attendance at the Autonomous University of Madrid.

cards.claim: Pablo Manzano Baena spent formative years at the University of Liverpool.
cards.quote: It was here, at the University of Liverpool, that he had spent some of the most formative years of his life, pouring over dusty tomes in the Harold Cohen Library and debating the intricacies of research methodology with his peers in the cramped, coffee-scented rooms of the Guild of Students.
